name: bug-on-an-unexpedited-epic-waits-for-approval
description: a bug raised on an epic that is not expedited files the fix task and starts nothing: its start gate is a real one, and the notice asks for the Approved that opens it

comment.body:
Bug: the discount is ignored on the checkout total
Steps: add SAVE10 to a cart of 100.00
Saw: total 100.00 — expected 90.00

contains: An implementer can start: comment `Approved` here
